l1_words.meaning: metaphor; a figure of speech that describes something as if it were something else
irony; a contrast between what is said and what is meant
media; the channels that carry news and information to the public
analysis; a detailed examination of something

pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from the same European source, so the spellings stayed close and the meanings match. Learners can rely on the resemblance and should still check the pronunciation, since stress patterns differ between the two languages.
